caption: The drawing shows a square-shaped pattern made up of repeated geometric shapes arranged in a grid. The main colors used are navy blue, red, and off-white or light beige. The grid consists of horizontal and vertical bands in navy blue, intersected by squares and rectangles in red and off-white. The red elements form cross-shaped clusters, appearing at every intersection of the blue bands, while the off-white areas contain smaller grid-like black rectangles or dots arranged evenly within squares and rectangles. The composition is symmetrical, with alternating positioning of the colored elements, filling the interior and stopping at the edges of the pattern, which is set against a plain, light beige background. The name "BYRON A. DIXSON" is printed in small black letters in the lower right corner.
title: Woven Textile
